Pump in Operation

Measure vibrations level for bearings and 
 compare it with the setting value, then analyze it and determine what to do.

Check discharge quantity and pressure and 
 compare them with the setting value then replace the worn-out components.

sections.text: Pump out of Operation
Remove the protective cover of the coupling.
Check alignment between motor and pump.
Shift electric motor away from the coupling.

Disconnect auxiliary piping for cooling and 
 for packing water.

Screw out screw fixing bracket base to base 
 plate.

Attach carrying rope to the upper arm of the 
 lantern.

Screw out gradually all screws connecting 
 lantern and spiral, then Move spiral with the help of forcing off screws.

Take out carefully the whole rotor from spiral 
 box and shift it towards the motor.

Screw out plug from the bottom part of the 
 bracket and let out oil.

قم بفك صامولة العداء، ثم قم بإزالة الصامولة الميكانيكية 
 غالاند على التوالي مع غسالة الجوز عداء (باستخدام ساحبة إزالة عداء و 
 أخرج الزنبرك المناسب من العمود).

Force out the cover of the spiral from the 
 lantern with the help of two screw drivers and remove it carefully.

Separate lantern from bracket by unscrewing 
 nuts.
Remove protective casing from the shaft.

Pull down the coupling half from the shaft 
 with a puller and remove coupling spring from the shaft.

قم بإزالة أغطية أقواس المحمل 
 بعد فك الجوز القفل.

Knock out the shaft to the side of the free 
 end (towards the coupling) with the help of a wooden block.

Heat up the bearing of the free end side and 
 remove it from the shaft.

Shift the shaft with the second bearing back 
 to the opposite side towards the runner, then heat up the bearing and remove 
 it from the shaft.

sections.text: حَشد

تسخين المحامل الجديدة في حمام الزيت و 
 أدخلها على العمود النظيف.

Install the covers of the bearings and seal 
 them against the bracket.

Insert new GUFERO rings with covers through 
 oiled shaft.

Pay special attention to the cleanliness of 
 the sealing surfaces during inserting packing.

Smear all threads with grease or with MOLYKA, 
 if it is working in aggressive environment and in pumps located on open air 
 sites.

Mounting the mechanical gland on the shaft of 
 the pump.

Mounting the impeller on the shaft end of the 
 pump.
Tighten firmly runner nut.
Mounting the coupling half on the shaft

Mounting carefully whole rotor in the spiral 
 box and tighten it.
Connecting auxiliary piping for cooling

After completing the assembly alignment the 
 flexible coupling of the pump and the motor (allowance 0.05 mm).
Put the protective cover of the coupling

sections.text: Starting of Pump

Check the direction of rotation of pump before 
 starting the pump for the first time.

Check the quantity of oil in the 
 thrust-bearing sump.

Open the inlet for cooling the oil bath of the 
 thrust bearing.

Check whether the inlet for flooding the 
 stuffing box is open.

Check whether the inlet for hydraulic sealing 
 of the suspension is open.

Check whether the delivery sluice valve is 
 closed.

Open the delivery valve gradually after the 
 set has been started to operate at its full speed.
